**7B.10 Research Note: Joe Biden in 2024**

Overall read: mixed, leaning negative. Biden repeatedly signaled respect for institutional norms and public scrutiny, but the year also includes clear trust-damaging counterexamples: a family pardon after an opposite promise, plus multiple high-salience false or misleading claims.

**Supports public trust**
- [Statement on World Press Freedom Day](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/statement-world-press-freedom-day-8) - The American Presidency Project / White House, 2024-05-03. Biden said journalism should not be criminalized and framed a free press as essential to democracy, which models openness to scrutiny rather than cynicism. IDs: `7B.10`, `4B.6`.

- [Address the Nation on the 2024 Presidential Election](https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election) - The American Presidency Project / White House, 2024-11-07. Biden accepted Trump’s victory, called for an orderly transition, and treated peaceful transfer as the norm, which is strong trust-building behavior. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.8`.

- [Justice Department finds civil rights violations at Phoenix Police Department and City of Phoenix](https://www.justice.gov/archives/opa/pr/justice-department-finds-civil-rights-violations-phoenix-police-department-and-city-phoenix) - U.S. Department of Justice, 2024-06-13. DOJ publicly documented unconstitutional policing and discriminatory enforcement, showing a willingness to surface abuse rather than excuse it. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.9`.

- [Biden-Harris Administration Announces CHIPS Incentives Award with Samsung](https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/12/biden-harris-administration-announces-chips-incentives-award-samsung) - U.S. Department of Commerce, 2024-12-20. Commerce said the award followed due diligence and milestone conditions, which supports a rules-based, non-self-dealing administrative style. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.9`.

**Undermines public trust**
- [Factbox: US reactions to Hunter Biden's pardon by President Biden](https://reuters.screenocean.com/record/1865844/media_id/1650308) - Reuters Archive Licensing, 2024-12-06. Biden pardoned his son after repeatedly saying he would let the justice system run its course, which is the clearest family-favoritism and promise-reversal counterexample. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.9`, `7B.8`.

- [Factchecking Biden on Inflation, Other Claims](https://www.factcheck.org/2024/05/factchecking-biden-on-inflation-other-claims/) - FactCheck.org, 2024-05-10. Biden falsely claimed he inherited 9% inflation; the fact-check shows it was 1.4% when he took office. This is direct evidence of a misleading public statement on a reputation-sensitive issue. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `4B.6`.

- [Biden Makes False Claim About Jan. 6 Capitol Attack](https://www.factcheck.org/2024/02/biden-makes-false-claim-about-jan-6-capitol-attack/) - FactCheck.org, 2024-02-02. Biden said officers were killed on Jan. 6, but no officers were killed that day, making this another clear public factual error. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.8`, `4B.6`.

- [Biden Eyes Big White House Shakeup as Campaigns Sputter](https://www.axios.com/2024/07/12/biden-election-inner-circle-withdrawal-criticism) - Axios, 2024-07-12. Axios reported a shrinking inner circle that filtered bad news and elevated loyalty, which is indirect but relevant evidence of a defensive, non-self-correcting information culture. IDs: `7B.10`, `7B.9`.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a strong 2024 record of broad, proven corruption in appointments or procurement beyond the Hunter pardon.
- The weakest but still relevant negative lane is information handling: allegations of platform pressure and an insular inner circle suggest trust erosion, but the platform-pressure material is still allegation-level rather than a merits finding.
